ideas.pitch: A localized defense-tech edge node using ESP32 and Arduino to detect, classify, and track unauthorized drone signatures locally without cloud dependency, running lightweight deterministic engagement gates.
ideas.title: EdgeDefender: Jam-Resilient Autonomous Counter-UAS Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the Defence and Security problem domain with a physical hardware prototype, leveraging the Aegis-Edge pattern of jam-resilient edge security.

ideas.pitch: An embedded biomedical system built on Raspberry Pi that performs real-time edge anomaly detection on patient vitals, triggering local haptic alerts without relying on unstable hospital Wi-Fi.
ideas.title: BioEdge: Real-Time Post-Operative Vitals Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Biomedical Engineering domain while implementing the hard-engineering edge-computing telemetry pattern proven in HardHack winners.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-accelerated water quality monitoring unit using an FPGA platform to process multi-sensor telemetry streams and predict contamination risks locally at the water source.
ideas.title: AquaSense FPGA: Real-Time Algal Bloom Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the FPGA track specifically, offering high-performance parallel data processing that wins hardware evaluation rounds.

ideas.pitch: A Renesas/Raspberry Pi powered edge vision system that detects missing PPE (helmets, vests) on workers in real-time through a local camera feed, logging violations offline.
ideas.title: SafeSite: Edge AI Industrial Safety Compliance Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the winning industrial safety detection system pattern with a working physical edge-vision live demo.

ideas.pitch: An ESP32-driven autonomous rover navigating agricultural rows to capture leaf multispectral images and perform immediate disease classification on the edge.
ideas.title: AgriRover: Autonomous Crop Health Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines unusual physical hardware building with computer vision, matching the award-winning Rover and garbage classifier patterns.
